items.claim: DORA III（2027–2031）核定 WACC 為 2.32%
items.quote: has been finally set at 2.32%
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: DORA III 年均機場收費漲幅 0.33%
items.quote: the average annual airport charges increase will be 0.33%
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: DORA 假設西班牙機場網絡 2031 年旅客數達 3.63 億
items.quote: will reach 363 million passengers in 2031
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 核定受管制投資計畫接近 100 億歐元
items.quote: regulated investment plan amounts to almost EUR 10 billion
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 含非受管制商業投資，總投資接近 130 億歐元
items.quote: the total investment will reach almost EUR 13 billion
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: DORA III 受管制成本以2026年固定價格計，2027年19.29億歐元升至2031年20.79億歐元
items.quote: from EUR 1,929 million in 2027 to EUR 2,079 million in 2031
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 2025年受管制成本為16.5億歐元，DORA III起點重設至19.29億
items.quote: the figure was EUR 1,650 million
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 管理層解釋成本重設原因：環保、安全、資安規範趨嚴與通膨、基本工資上調
items.quote: So doing the same costs more money
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 受管制OpEx對ATU比率年增近2%
items.quote: the ratio of OpEx to ATUs will increase almost 2% annually
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 新策略計畫（2027–2031）將於年底前發布
items.quote: before the end of the year, our new strategic plan
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 董事長預告策略計畫中的財務目標企圖心偏高
items.quote: I can anticipate will be high in many of the financial targets
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 管理層列出兩大優先事項：OpEx 與 CapEx 執行，並稱兩者與過往 DORA 明顯不同
items.quote: One is OpEx. Two is the CapEx execution.
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 董事長形容本期 DORA 具挑戰性與高要求
items.quote: it is challenging, it is demanding
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 董事長稱核定投資使受管制業務價值提高，但需達成各項要求才能實現
items.quote: Aena's value is higher after the approval of DORA III
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 管理層表示投資增加將使債務大幅上升
items.quote: Our debt will increase significantly.
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 馬德里與巴塞隆納主要擴建多數在 DORA IV 交付，容量全面釋放在 DORA IV
items.quote: the whole capacity will be delivered in DORA IV
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 管理層承諾投資不超過核定的 100 億歐元
items.quote: We are not going to invest more than it has been approved
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 彈性工具：各機場只需執行核定投資額的 80%
items.quote: to comply with 80% of the investment that has been approved
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 策略性投資占 CapEx 計畫 40%–50%，須依時程執行
items.quote: between 40% and 50% of the CapEx program
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 策略性投資未達標可能受罰，因此超支時先動非策略項目
items.quote: you can receive a penalty
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 已發包的 CapEx 比例仍很低
items.quote: It's still very low, still very low.
items.speaker: CFO (Ignacio Castejón)

items.claim: CFO稱公司工程招標一向要求固定價格
items.quote: with fixed prices in order to avoid last-minute surprises
items.speaker: CFO (Ignacio Castejón)

items.claim: Tenerife South 航廈標案無人投標，技術部指市場評估的風險高於預期
items.quote: the risk that the market has assessed in this project
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 董事長承認 Tenerife 流標不是好消息，但稱因國家持股透明度才被公開
items.quote: it leaves you a bad taste in the mouth
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 董事長稱 Tenerife 流標情況並不令人擔憂
items.quote: this is not worrying
items.speaker: Maurici Lucena (Chairman/CEO)

items.claim: 通膨保護沿用法規定義的 P 因子；過渡期 1% 上限已不適用
items.quote: Now those limitations do not apply at this moment.
items.speaker: Javier Marin (Executive Vice Chairman)

items.claim: 非受管制 CapEx 的節奏請比照受管制 CapEx 建模，其餘留待策略計畫
items.quote: expect something similar to regulated CapEx
items.speaker: CFO (Ignacio Castejón)

items.claim: CFO稱將檢視公司提交的OpEx假設與核定版差異，並指出有履約不及的高風險項目
items.quote: a high risk of not being able to perform
items.speaker: CFO (Ignacio Castejón)

items.claim: 下次財報為10月底的2026前9個月業績
items.quote: at the end of October
items.speaker: Carlos Gallego (IR)

qa_flags.question: Bernstein：最終核定成本比初始假設低約10%，是否意外、差異在哪、如何控制成本
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 只回答 CapEx 招標部分，OpEx 差異未給數字，延後到策略計畫（請「給我們幾週」）

qa_flags.question: Jefferies：非受管制 CapEx 的節奏與零售投資的價值上行時點
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 表示留待策略計畫，只給 CapEx 節奏類似受管制一句，未回答價值上行

qa_flags.question: Deutsche Bank：已發包 CapEx 佔比
qa_flags.response_pattern: 只答「still very low」，未給百分比

qa_flags.question: BNP：標價高於預期時 100 億總額是否增加或順延至 DORA IV
qa_flags.response_pattern: 回答不超投資，但同時承認價格、部分專案仍有不確定性，並稱可能將部分投資延至 DORA IV
